pr_title: roachprod: add VM label for "spot" instance
pr_body:
what was there before: Previously, there was no way to identify spot instances using a label for tracking (billing)
why it needed to change: This was inadequate because the VMs can be tracked for billing using the added label
what you did about it: To address this, this patch adds a new tag as "spot:true"

Fixes: #119629
Epic: none

issue_context.title: roachprod: add VM label for "spot" instance
issue_context.body:
To facilitate tracking (billing) spend and preemption frequency of "spot" instances, we should add a VM label. Staying consistent with the current labeling scheme where boolean-valued labels are added iff the value is `true`, it should suffice to add `spot: true`. Below is a snapshot of current VM labels in GCE; same labels are also used with other clouds (AWS and Azure).

**NOTE**: let's also update `PrintDetails` in [`cluster_cloud.go`](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/c9c3cc5f3c3a4a6ab556f4b9d5b6ec0381901bdb/pkg/roachprod/cloud/cluster_cloud.go#L159) to append the `spot` column, when relevant. To make it easier to `grep`, we can elide the column if the cluster isn't using spot instances. Jira issue: CRDB-36220
comments: For the second requirement, I will use the “spot” keyword in the column for easy grep. The column value will be populated only if it is a spot instance.

review_comments:
I noticed that we used to write this cluster information on the `logger` passed to this function, but now we're writing straight to stdout.

This means that this information is now printed on TeamCity's "Build Log" instead of the corresponding cluster creation log as before (where I think it's more useful).

Can we revert back to writing this info to the logger?
